[b]__Update 0.4.4 (EARLY ACCESS)__ 5/24/2025[/b]

[b]Tailoring QTEs[/b]
[list]
[*] Added optional but rewarding QTE (quick-time events) when crafting on a Loom or Spinning Wheel,
[*] Loom Hero: Knots are sent through the loom. Press the correct Arrow key or click/tap the button at the right time to complete,
[*] Skill Check Wheel: A handle spins around the wheel. Hit the button or press Space when the handle is over the highlighted zone to complete,
[*] Rewards for completing these QTEs include receiving double XP for a craft, saving an input material, or triggering a second craft immediately.,
[*] Completing it successfully will show a progress ribbon in the top-left with your reward,
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Karma drain is now shown on karma skill tooltips,
[*] Update color of fiberglass armor,
[*] Improved ground tiles around HoB entrance,

[*] Added a rare skilling pet to beehives,
[*] Removed long respawn delay on the Giant Snake,
[*] You can link your account to you Patreon account in the Account tab in settings. This has no effect atm, but it will in the future!,
[/list]

[list]

Next update, we will try to catch up on adding cosmetics to the cash shop!
